name: One plus three cards
description: A title and three equal cards; a card holds a short phrase or a big number. A bullet list would lose the sense of three separate, parallel things.

title.hint: one-line title that covers all three cards

card-1.hint: a short phrase or a metric (big number, label, delta); may carry details (the full content that expands when the card is clicked during playback)

card-3.hint: same as above; with only two cards, hide it with an override or leave it empty
